verdict.rationale: Auth0's own docs show Organizations as a first-party feature for modelling B2B customers in a single tenant, covering membership management, per-organization branding and connections, plus a My Organization API and pre-built components so customer admins can self-serve. Invitation flows are never mentioned in the evidence, so only two of the story's three elements are documented. Missing for 10: documented invitation flows, depth of the membership-management docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can model multi-tenant B2B apps with organizations, memberships, and invitation flows out of the box

citations.quote: Represent their business customers and partners in Auth0 and manage their membership.
Use Auth0 Organizations to manage multiple B2B customers in a single tenant with per-organization branding, connections, members
Deliver custom in-app administrative experiences with My Organization API, or embed our pre-built, white-labeled components.
